Core Features Overview

Instrument Support

IFU Analyzer handles data from multiple telescopes and instruments. See Instruments for details on each.

Advanced Analysis

Comprehensive tools for spectroscopic analysis including Gaussian fitting, continuum subtraction, and specialized CO flux extraction. See Analysis Techniques.

Interactive Visualization

Powerful display options with multiple colormaps, color scales, and interactive controls. See Colormaps.

Data Handling

Efficient handling of large spectral cubes with intelligent memory management and region-based analysis.

Publication-Ready Output

Export analysis results in formats suitable for publication and external analysis tools.
